posts.caption:
The first two Fridays of December are stacked 🗓️

Slayyyter drops the partner album to WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA, SOAK is back with a new record, Post Malone adds eight unheard songs to Stoney for its 10th birthday, and Oklou & ROB score a movie coming to Netflix.

Who on this list are you hearing for the first time?

Riffex is where fans back the artists they find first. Try the beta, link in bio.
